criteria.requirement: Add public html5lib.tokenizer.iter_tokens wrapping the actual internal HTMLTokenizer, yielding detached dictionaries with named token types and real production-time (line,column) checkpoints. Preserve data/attributes/entities/comments/Doctype and optional ParseError inclusion, stream encoding kwargs and caller stream ownership. A nonnegative max_tokens output budget raises TokenLimitError on overflow rather than pretending partial output is complete; bool/invalid budgets reject, empty input works and early close is safe. Do not label lexer events as repaired DOM nodes or fabricate exact start spans from end checkpoints.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
